import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('../first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]

green = (G > R+15) & (G > B+10)
blue  = (B > R+25) & (B > G+5)
dark  = (R<70)&(G<70)&(B<70)
print(\"green px:\", green.sum(), \"blue px:\", blue.sum(), \"dark:\", dark.sum())

def bbox(mask, name):
    ys,xs = np.where(mask)
    if len(xs):
        print(name, \"x\", xs.min(), xs.max(), \"y\", ys.min(), ys.max(), \"n=\", len(xs))
bbox(green,'green')
bbox(blue,'blue')
bbox(dark,'dark')

# Column/row projections
print(\"\\nGreen rows profile (every 4 rows):\")
for y in range(0,144,4):
    n = green[y].sum()
    if n: print(y, n, '#'*(n//3))
EOF"
